verdict.rationale: DBOS has a dedicated human-in-the-loop guide. A workflow blocks on `DBOS.recv(timeout_seconds=...)` for hours or days, survives restarts and upgrades while waiting, and resumes when `DBOS.send()` delivers the response, which DBOSClient can do from external code. An agent-inbox example shows workflows waiting on human input across process restarts and being surfaced for approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of long-wait human-in-the-loop resumption in practice.
